# The Sprint Project

> > Community-based sport psychology research advancing mental health, wellbeing, and safeguarding across dance, sport, and disadvantaged communities.

The Sprint Project is a University of Birmingham research initiative led by Dr Georgia Bird and team, conducting rigorous psychological research to improve outcomes in dance performance, athlete mental health, and vulnerable youth populations. The project combines evidence-based interventions like Mental Skills Training with policy-level safeguarding work and researcher wellbeing support.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health
- Mental Skills Training (MST)
- Sport Psychology
- Dance Research
- Safeguarding & Abuse Prevention
- Disadvantaged Communities
- Youth Homelessness
- Neurodiversity
- Researcher Wellbeing
- Paralympic Athletes
- Emotion Regulation
- Dancer Wellbeing
- One Dance UK Partnership
- University of Birmingham
- Evidence-Based Intervention

## Core Research Programs

- [The Sprint Project](https://www.sprintproject.org): Homepage and overview of SPRINT Project, a University of Birmingham community-based sport psychology research initiative.
- [Research Projects](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects): Overview of SPRINT Project research themes spanning dance, sport, and disadvantaged communities.
- [Sport Research Program](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-sport): Sport research covering mental health, neurodiversity, and athlete wellness across competitive and recreational contexts.
- [Dance Research Program](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-dance): Dance research program addressing mental health, safeguarding, and dancer wellbeing in partnership with One Dance UK.
- [Disadvantaged Communities Program](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-disadvantaged-communities): Research supporting vulnerable populations including care leavers, NEET youth, and families at risk of homelessness.

## Dance & Safeguarding

- [Dance Mental Health](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-dance-mental-health): Research with One Dance UK examining protective and risk factors for dancer mental health and psychological wellbeing.
- [Safeguarding & Abuse Prevention](https://www.sprintproject.org/safeguarding-abuse): Dance safeguarding and abuse prevention research with One Dance UK, developing sector-wide protective practices.
- [National Dance Safeguarding Survey](https://www.sprintproject.org/national-survey): National survey of dance sector safeguarding practices with policy recommendations for abuse prevention.

## Athlete Mental Health & Performance

- [Athlete Mental Health](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-sport-mental-health): Research on athlete mental health including transition, emotion regulation, help-seeking behaviors, and psychological support.
- [Paralympic Mental Health](https://www.sprintproject.org/paralympic): Paralympic athlete mental health consensus statement developed with UK Sports Institute and expert stakeholders.
- [Mental Skills Training (MST)](https://www.sprintproject.org/mst): Evidence-based Mental Skills Training intervention program research for dancers and athletes to enhance psychological performance.
- [Mental Imagery in Sport](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-imagery): Mental imagery research tools including SIAQ and MIQ-3 questionnaires for assessing athlete visualization abilities.
- [Sport Neurodiversity](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-sport-neurodiversity): Research on ADHD inclusion in sport, coaching practices for neurodivergent athletes, and accessible performance support.

## Youth & Community Interventions

- [MST4Life Residential Program](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-disadvantaged-communities-mst4life): MST4Life residential intervention in Lake District for NEET youth, applying Mental Skills Training to life skills development.
- [Parenting Support for Youth Homelessness Prevention](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-disadvantaged-communities-parenting): Parenting support program in partnership with St Basils addressing youth homelessness prevention and family resilience.
- [Care Leavers Housing Pathways](https://www.sprintproject.org/projects-disadvantaged-communities-care-leavers): Care leavers research with Local Government Association examining housing pathways and transition support outcomes.

## Researcher Wellbeing & Support

- [Researcher Mental Health](https://www.sprintproject.org/researcher-mental-health): Research with UKRI on researcher mental health and support in emotionally demanding research contexts.
- [Researcher Wellbeing Guidelines](https://www.sprintproject.org/guidelines): Guidelines and best practices for supporting researcher mental health and managing emotionally demanding research.

## Research Impact & Dissemination

- [Research Impact](https://www.sprintproject.org/impact): Impact case study demonstrating MST4Life outcomes on youth homelessness prevention and social mobility.
- [Research Dissemination](https://www.sprintproject.org/dissemination): Dissemination of SPRINT research across dance, sport, and disadvantaged communities to practitioners and policymakers.
